description: This Swift file defines an enum `PlatformLabelFormatter` with static methods for parsing and prettifying platform labels such as 'macos', 'ios', etc. It provides utility functions to interpret raw platform strings into formatted human-readable form.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a raw platform label string into a tuple containing a prefix and optional version.

methods.name: pretty
methods.description: Converts a raw platform label string into a prettified, human-readable platform name with optional version.
